columns.description: Row number for each unit / lease line

columns.label: Category
columns.description: Asset or unit type (office, retail, industrial etc.)
columns.sourceHint: Lease (permitted use, premises description), sales brochure

columns.label: Unit Name
columns.description: Name of the demise as described in the lease

columns.label: Building
columns.description: Building or estate the unit sits in

columns.label: Unit Suite
columns.description: Suite or unit number within the building

columns.label: Floor
columns.description: Floor(s) the demise occupies

columns.label: Unit Area Sqft
columns.description: Floor area of the demise
columns.sourceHint: Measured survey; sometimes the lease or rent review clause

columns.label: Area Basis
columns.description: Measurement standard used (NIA, GIA, IPMS)

columns.label: Permitted Use
columns.description: Use the tenant is allowed to make of the premises, including use class

columns.label: Car Spaces
columns.description: Number of parking spaces demised or licensed

columns.label: EPC
columns.description: Energy rating, A to G

columns.label: EPC Expiry
columns.description: Date the certificate lapses (10 years from issue)

columns.label: Y/N
columns.description: Whether the unit is let or vacant
columns.sourceHint: Existence of a current lease; tenancy schedule

columns.label: Tenant Name
columns.description: Legal entity that is the current tenant
columns.sourceHint: Lease, or latest licence to assign / deed of assignment

columns.label: Tenant Co. No.
columns.description: Tenant's company registration number

columns.label: Guarantor
columns.description: Any party guaranteeing the tenant's obligations
columns.sourceHint: Lease, deed of guarantee, authorised guarantee agreement

columns.label: Lease Type
columns.description: Form of occupation (lease, underlease, licence, tenancy at will, agreement for lease)

columns.label: 1954 Act In / Out
columns.description: Whether the tenant has security of tenure under the Landlord and Tenant Act 1954
columns.sourceHint: Lease (exclusion clause), landlord's warning notice and tenant's declaration

columns.label: Lease Start
columns.description: Term commencement date

columns.label: Break Date
columns.description: Date on which the lease can be ended early

columns.label: Break Party
columns.description: Who holds the break: landlord, tenant or mutual

columns.label: Break Notice Mths
columns.description: Minimum written notice needed to exercise the break

columns.label: Break Penalty £
columns.description: Payment due from the tenant if it exercises the break

columns.label: Expiry Date
columns.description: Contractual end of the term

columns.label: Rent Review Date
columns.description: Next review date

columns.label: Rent Review Frequency
columns.description: Review pattern, e.g. every 5 years or annual

columns.label: Rent Review Basis
columns.description: How the reviewed rent is set: open market, RPI, CPI, fixed uplift

columns.label: Upward Only Y/N
columns.description: Whether the rent can fall on review

columns.label: Rent Review Cap
columns.description: Maximum uplift on an indexed review

columns.label: Rent Review Collar
columns.description: Minimum uplift on an indexed review

columns.label: Rent Free Start Date
columns.description: First day of the rent free period
columns.sourceHint: Lease, agreement for lease, side letter

columns.label: Rent Free End Date
columns.description: Last day of the rent free period (rent commencement date follows)
columns.sourceHint: Lease, agreement for lease, side letter

columns.label: Rent Free % Rent
columns.description: Share of rent waived in that period (100% for full rent free, 50% for half rent)

columns.label: £
columns.description: Cash paid by the landlord to the tenant as an incentive, usually towards fit-out

columns.label: £
columns.description: Annual rent currently reserved under the lease
columns.sourceHint: Lease, rent review memorandum, deed of variation

columns.label: £psf
columns.description: Contracted rent divided by area

columns.label: Frequency
columns.description: How often rent is paid (quarterly, monthly)

columns.label: Advance / Arrears
columns.description: Whether rent is paid at the start or end of each period

columns.label: Step Date
columns.description: Date a pre-agreed rent change takes effect

columns.label: £
columns.description: Annual rent from the step date

columns.label: £psf
columns.description: Stepped rent divided by area

columns.label: % Turnover
columns.description: Share of tenant's turnover payable as rent, on top of or instead of base rent

columns.label: £
columns.description: Estimated market rent for the unit
columns.sourceHint: Valuation report, agent's letting advice (not in the lease)

columns.label: £psf
columns.description: ERV divided by area

columns.label: £
columns.description: Annual service charge payable by the tenant
columns.sourceHint: Service charge budget and apportionment schedule; lease for the mechanism

columns.label: £psf
columns.description: Service charge divided by area

columns.label: Cap
columns.description: Limit on what the tenant can be charged

columns.label: Collar
columns.description: Minimum the tenant pays

columns.label: £
columns.description: Tenant's contribution to the landlord's buildings insurance premium
columns.sourceHint: Insurance schedule or demand; lease for the obligation

columns.label: £
columns.description: Cash security held against tenant default

columns.label: FRI / IRI
columns.description: Extent of the tenant's repairing liability (full, internal only, or via service charge)

columns.label: Y / N
columns.description: Whether repair liability is limited to the condition recorded at lease start

columns.label: Y / N
columns.description: Whether the tenant must remove alterations and reinstate at lease end
columns.sourceHint: Lease (yielding up clause), licence for alterations

columns.label: Assign / Underlet
columns.description: Whether the tenant can assign or underlet, and on what terms

columns.label: Y / N
columns.description: Whether documents outside the lease change its terms

columns.label: Comment
columns.description: Free text for anything that does not fit a column, e.g. second break dates or personal concessions
